sources.title: Sensitivity of Crops to Weather & Climate
sources.organization: Department of Agricultural Extension, hosted by BAMIS
sources.method: Published PDF text inspected with web retrieval; image screenshot retrieval failed with cache miss
sources.finding: Explains that crop calendars contain stages, normal weather, crop requirements, warnings and pest/disease conditions as distinct information roles.
sources.not_established: No collection-specific climate reference period, standard-week convention or per-field aggregation was established from this material.
sources.reuse_rights: unreviewed; no original PDF or images copied into the repository

sources.title: Concept & Scope of Agrometeorology
sources.organization: Department of Agricultural Extension, hosted by BAMIS
sources.method: Published PDF text inspected with web retrieval; sample-calendar screenshot retrieval failed with cache miss
sources.finding: Discusses calendar weather warnings, normal weather and conditions favourable to pests and diseases. General observation descriptions do not establish how the retained regional normals were computed.
sources.not_established: No verified definition of daily/weekly aggregation, reference years or standard-week date boundaries for the imported calendar collection.
sources.reuse_rights: unreviewed; no original PDF or images copied into the repository

sources.title: Lentil regional calendar listing
sources.method: Official listing inspected through web search
sources.finding: Lists 13 regional choices, consistent with the 13 Lentil documents in the preserved extraction. Rangamati is not among the listed regions; absence does not establish unsuitability.
